{{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Bug |trainername=Goh |pokemonname=Caterpie |jtrainername=ゴウ |jpokemonname=キャタピー |tmtrainername=Go |tmpokemonname=Caterpie |image=[[File:Goh Caterpie.png|250px]] |caption=Goh's Caterpie |prevonum=010 |epnum=JN006 |epname=Working My Way Back to Mew! |location=[[Vermilion Forest]] |current=[[Cerise Laboratory|Cerise Park]] |gender=Unknown |ability=Unknown |java1=[[Rikako Aikawa]] |enva1= }} '''Goh's Caterpie''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのキャタピー ''' ''Go's Caterpie'') is the first {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Kanto]] [[region]], and his second overall. ==In animation== ===History=== ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== [[File:Goh and Caterpie.png|thumb|left|250px|Caterpie and Goh]] {{p|Caterpie}} debuted in ''[[JN006|Working My Way Back to Mew!]]''. [[Goh]] found it munching on a leaf, and, wanting to make it his first capture of the day, snuck up on it and threw a {{i|Poké Ball}}. This capture inspired Goh to obtain one Pokémon of every {{type|Bug}} Pokémon native to the [[Kanto]] [[region]], which he achieved by the end of the day. Afterwards, it was seen with all of his other Pokémon before [[Professor Cerise]] suggested leaving it at his [[Cerise Laboratory|Laboratory]]. In ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'', Caterpie was one of the Pokémon that suffered from a lack of food at the Cerise Laboratory. It, along with {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Weedle}}, were threatened by {{TP|Goh|Grimer}} after it accused them of eating more than their share. In the end, after the conflict grew worse, Caterpie joined the Laboratory's other Pokémon to help Goh's three {{p|Cascoon}} [[Evolution|evolve]] safely into {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Dustox}}. In ''[[JN046|Getting More Than You Battled For!]]'', Caterpie used its {{m|String Shot}} to make a zip line for Goh and {{Ash}} to cross a river. In ''[[JN102|Battling in the Freezing Raid!]]'', Caterpie used its String Shot twice to help Goh descend deeper into the [[Seafoam Islands]]. In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', Caterpie attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure. ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Goh Caterpie and Weedle.png|thumb|250px|Caterpie and Weedle]] Caterpie was shown to enjoy staying active, participating in [[Mimey]]'s kung fu exercises. It also expressed concern after {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Metapod}} was kicked by {{TP|Goh|Scorbunny}}. It is shown to spend most of its time around other Bug types since arriving at the park and is often seen next to {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Weedle}}. It does not enjoy battling, staying away from any form of conflict and growing upset if confronted. Its String Shot is shown to be very durable and is often used as a means to help Goh navigate difficult terrain. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|bug||Goh Caterpie String Shot.png|Using String Shot}} {{anmov|bug|String Shot|JN046|Getting More Than You Battled For!}} {{anmov/f|bug}} ===Artwork=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{bug color dark}}; background: #{{bug color}}; font-size:80%;" |- | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{bug color dark}}; background: #{{bug color light}}"| [[File:JN006 illustration.png|x250px]] |- | Official artwork of
''{{color2|000|JN006|Working My Way Back to Mew!}}'' |} ==In the manga== [[File:Goh Bug Pokémon JNM.png|220px|thumb|right|Caterpie (along with Goh's other Bug Pokémon) in {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}}]] ===Pokémon Journeys=== Caterpie debuted in ''[[JNM03|Battle Frontier Challenge: The Flute Cup!]]''. {{-}} ==Trivia== * Caterpie is Goh's first {{type|Bug}} and [[Generation I]] {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. * Similar to how {{AP|Caterpie}} was {{Ash}}'s first [[caught Pokémon]] after he obtained [[Ash's Pikachu|his first Pokémon]], Caterpie was also the first Pokémon Goh caught after obtaining [[Goh's Cinderace|his own first Pokémon]]. ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Caterpie}} {{Goh's Pokémon|bug}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Goh's Pokémon|Caterpie]] [[es:Caterpie de Goh]] [[it:Caterpie di Goh]]
